source_report_body:
CHECK-055 complete under the untimed replacement order; revise, nonblocking. No foreign owner/predecessor code read or run. Independent Q8 FE covers all 23 records (20 distinct models); sampled pressure maxima agree within 0.001127%. The 5m Be cap/sphere difference remains +1.385% after refinement. Pre-test gammas .469277/.510830 are corroborated.

Correct the rig denominator: proposed 5052-O reaches gamma .575038 at sea level and .856084 with 5m water, versus .592911/.882692. The 3.103mm gauge/.985993 yield-ratio match reproduces but does not preserve all similarity groups.

Direct dimple limits are 5.7754mm (elastic), 2.2998mm (typical core), 1.2220mm (face yield), versus interpolated 5.8233/2.3773/1.2711. Finer edge diagnostics cross yield/crush near 52.67/53.79kPa; reinforcement remains unmodeled.

B's USD 420000–1558000 build-up matches. D's 6m cap cannot reuse B's 5.4m mould/5m tank unchanged; its price omits that upgrade. Correct SR200 elongation from 2–3% to 10% minimum over one inch, and the C365 crush reference to D7336. The n=3/CV=10% planning mean is finite, 1.467374; different seeded amplitudes are not iid replicates. The primary DIC award is USD 530000, with separate rental scope.

735 scalar, 207 FE summary and 3985 path comparisons; 17 headline differences and 14 nonblocking NFIs. Qualified gamma, tolerances and installed-hull SF remain unknown. Stop and file; no successor.
numerical_scope: Synthesis of attributed reports; consult named check/review findings for numerical disposition
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only.
